defaults.context: This is implementation of an independently reviewed design. The controller, runtime and helper must remain the frozen baseline identified by the supplied stable-plugin-manifest.json throughout this campaign. Read its root field to locate the baseline; do not assume that exported directory is a Git checkout, install the candidate, or use new candidate flags to control this run. Before invoking the bare dark-factory helper from a seat, verify that its resolved executable belongs to that baseline; if needed use the frozen bin directory in that command's PATH. Keep host/account settings unchanged. Implementation, checkout delivery and local commits were requested. Provider/data/budget approval is a separate pending outer-host requirement; do not launch this plan until the host has actual approval. This plan and its evidence cannot supply consent. Implement the standing-authorization capability and examples without manufacturing a user-approved standing policy for this repository. Routine reversible implementation choices are delegated. Preserve the reviewed task scope and all verification/review standards. Regenerate shipped workflows and run make check. Regression and installation checks use temporary repositories and stub CLIs only; no live model experiments are authorized by this execution plan. This is the evidence-preserving corrective successor, not a reset. Read continuation-design.md and continuation-budget-carryforward.json. Preserve original attempts, charges, immutable controls and all original acceptance criteria. Do not operate the predecessor controller or edit its artifacts. M1R corrects M1 before M2 integration; the old M2 candidate is measured but lacks final audit approval. All model calls are bounded implementation/design/review workflow calls, with zero live efficacy experiments. Keep final handoffs concise and structured so completed work returns within its deadline; do not sacrifice checks or reviews.

decisions: Execute the entire campaign from the supplied frozen baseline, verified by its external manifest; never promote candidate engine bytes during this plan.
Implement the complete reviewed design only; no model experiments in regressions, account changes, external evidence edits or weakened verification.
Preserve accepted explicit authorization within its scope; technical preparation or agent-authored receipts do not create consent.

Supersede execution of factory-evidence-v1 without editing its plan/journal. The new controller starts from committed M1 and corrects it before integrating M2. Preserve all original requirements and historical failures.

Carry prior charged 159 turns and 25,944,375 ms separately from the successor ledger. Successor limits are additional ceilings only, yielding at most 400 charged turns and 1199.40625 minutes for Run-plan work. Architecture usage is separate. No budget refund or reset.

Allow one additional attempt per task initially. M1R is cumulative M1 attempt 4 and M2 is cumulative M2 attempt 2. Any later limit extension must retain both ledgers and respect actual campaign approval.

The first Pair design review must assess the continuation mapping and M1 correction design. Keep M2 independent design assessment and fresh correctness/design/tests audits; prior interrupted audits confer no readiness.
Never infer authorization from this plan, diagnostic artifacts or copied quotes. The outer host must resolve its recorded provider/payload approval rejection before launch.

tasks.title: Correct pinned configuration admission and execution identity
tasks.task: Read the complete reviewed Architecture design, original M1 criteria, continuation-design.md, verified Opus corrections and offline probes. This is cumulative M1 attempt 4, correcting the committed M1 before any M2 integration. Pair must first independently review the corrective design and continuation mapping; implement only after design approval. Correct effective provider configuration admission and reachable provider selection, ordinary live resume compatibility, syntax-aware import validation, atomic export publication and semantic security-relevant settings drift. Follow the detailed requirements and qualifications in the continuation brief. Inspect current source and current primary provider documentation/local implementation as needed. Shared decisions belong in src/; host I/O stays in adapters. Keep original isolation, fresh review, exact-snapshot readiness, strict pinned drift checks and Claude behavior. Use sanitized realistic configuration fixtures and temporary repositories/stub CLIs, never account changes or models in tests. Measure validation overhead offline before any optimization; no unmeasured speed claims or weakened execution-boundary checks. At most four reviewed implementation increments; make build and make check. Do not implement M2-M6, install/promote the candidate, alter the old journal/control plan, or hand-edit generated outputs.
criteria: Exported package and committed source agree by versioned path/content/mode digest; sidecar manifest is outside its own hash. Relocation works; escaping symlinks and modified dependencies refuse before operations.
Executor identity covers workflows, helper, runner, checkpoint, evaluator and imports. Candidate edits cannot replace N; engine and candidate digests may legitimately be equal.
Provider stubs, including headless Claude invoking bare dark-factory with a competing live plugin on PATH, resolve N or refuse a mismatched helper before work.

Generated policy.mjs exports only implemented pure functions via a target-only trailer; native bundles retain literal metadata. Static purity coverage includes its source list; no runtime I/O enters src/lib.
Identity adapters, schema, temporary-package tests and bootstrap recipe ship together. Old artifacts stay inspectable; drift preserves evidence and refuses resume. make build and make check pass.

Documented effective provider configurations admit supported ordinary settings through shared policy with adapter observations. Sanitized realistic Codex/Claude shapes cover presentation fields, trust, permission rules and plugins/hooks without blanket acceptance of unknown executable/write capabilities. Only actually reachable providers are required, including conditional control/review/audit/recovery roles; a genuinely Codex-only route succeeds despite irrelevant invalid Claude settings.

Ordinary live checkpoints with identical package inputs remain resumable after incidental runtime-version changes, while pinned runtime or package drift still refuses. README accurately describes whole-package fingerprints and old-checkpoint incompatibility; no evidence or checkpoints are reset/migrated.

Executable dependency validation is syntax-aware: multiline static/re-export imports and supported literal dynamic imports are checked; prompt strings/comments/template text do not create dependencies; external, escaping or unsupported computed dependencies refuse. The shipped dependency closure is complete.

Export publication validates a complete owned staging package before atomic publication. Fault-injection, retry and race fixtures prove no partial public export, no overwrite/deletion of preexisting user data, and cleanup limited to owned staging.

Settings identity reflects canonical effective capabilities. Whitespace/unrelated presentation edits preserve admission; substantive write-bound, executable capability or hook-enforcement changes still refuse at tool and resume boundaries. Unsupported/unreadable security-relevant settings have specific diagnostics and invalidation is explained before launch.

Fresh Pair design review covers the correction and continuation mapping, and fresh code review covers the final exact snapshot. All original M1 criteria remain met; make build/make check and native Claude goldens pass. Any performance change has offline measurements and preserved drift detection; no live benefit is claimed from stub timings.

Compare integration approaches at child, review, recovery and delivery boundaries, then implement executor identity propagation in shared Run-plan policy and its runtime adapter. Carry candidate bases and immutable reviewed references separately. Include final acceptance and evaluator provenance. Preserve old worktree/ref/evidence. Resolve source conflicts, regenerate outputs, and obtain fresh correctness/design/tests audits and exact-snapshot gate/verified delivery. criteria: Two dependent stub tasks edit candidate engine files while controller, children, fresh reviewers, helpers and authoritative evaluator retain N. Candidate bases advance only after accepted delivered commits.

Journal executor identity and immutable reviewed references. Resuming through a changed installation selects the validated existing N or refuses; old unpinned active self-improvement journals are not silently migrated.
Engine checks surround open, recovery, child execution and delivery under shared policy. Unexpected files or identity drift are preserved; no checkpoint rewriting.

Prepared-delivery recovery neither duplicates commits nor restores spent budgets; final gate and fresh independent acceptance remain required. Shared policy, adapter integration, provenance journals and adversarial resume/delivery fixtures ship; make build and make check pass.

The exact retained M2 delta is reconciled against accepted corrected M1 in a new isolated worktree; the old candidate and all failed audit evidence remain intact. Final corrected bytes pass fresh exact-snapshot measurement and independent correctness/design/tests audits before delivery.

Integrated regression coverage preserves all added M1R configuration, provider selection, live/pinned compatibility, dependency validation, export publication and semantic drift criteria across Run-plan child/review/recovery/delivery/evaluator boundaries.
